description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's binary diff and apply functionalities, including applying patches, detecting corruptions, and handling binary files in various scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_must_fail

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files.
